app.name: Sahakar Sathi
app.tagline: Your multilingual digital assistant for cooperative services, schemes, insurance and financial guidance.

home.heroHeading: Get clear answers about cooperative services in your language.
home.heroSub: Ask about schemes, crop insurance, PACS, cooperative rules, money matters, or how to file a grievance. You can type or speak.
home.askPlaceholder: Type your question, for example: Am I eligible for PMFBY?
examples: Am I eligible for PMFBY crop insurance?
How do I become a cooperative member?
How can I file a cooperative grievance?
home.grievanceCalloutTitle: Have a complaint about a cooperative or PACS?
home.grievanceCalloutBody: Raise it here. You will get a tracking number and can check the status any time.
home.trustNote: Answers are drawn from official government and cooperative sources where available. The assistant clearly marks what is verified and what is a plain-language explanation.

grievance.title: File a grievance
grievance.intro: Raise a complaint about a cooperative society, a PACS, a scheme benefit, or related services. You will get a tracking number and can check the status any time.
grievance.alreadyHaveId: I already have a tracking number — check status
grievance.descriptionHint: What happened, when, and which society or office is involved. You can type or use the microphone.
grievance.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain the problem in your own words…
grievance.contactHint: So the office can reach you about this grievance.
grievance.attachmentsHint: Up to {{max}} files, {{mb}} MB each. PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP.
grievance.privacyNote: Your grievance and any documents are shared only with the officers who handle it.
grievance.chooseCategory: Please choose what the grievance is about.
grievance.submitFailed: The grievance could not be submitted. Please try again.
grievance.uploadFailed: That file could not be uploaded.
grievance.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
grievance.tooManyFiles: You can attach at most {{max}} files.
grievance.saveIdNote: Save this tracking number. You need it to check the status, especially if you are not signed in.
grievance.trackIntro: Enter the tracking number you received when you filed the grievance.
grievance.noIdYet: I need to file a new grievance

statusHelp.SUBMITTED: Your grievance has been received and logged.
statusHelp.UNDER_REVIEW: An officer is checking the details and category.
statusHelp.ASSIGNED: It has been assigned to the officer or office responsible.
statusHelp.IN_PROGRESS: The office is working on it and may contact you.
statusHelp.RESOLVED: Action has been taken. You can respond if it is not settled.
statusHelp.CLOSED: The grievance is closed. No further action is pending.

schemes.title: Government schemes
schemes.intro: Find schemes for farmers and cooperative members. Filter by who can apply, then open a scheme to see eligibility, benefits, documents and how to apply.
schemes.askExample: Which government schemes am I eligible for as a farmer?

cooperative_law.title: Cooperative law & governance
cooperative_law.intro: How cooperative societies work — membership, rights, duties, elections, meetings, by-laws and disputes. Each topic has a simple explanation and a detailed reference.
cooperative_law.askExample: Explain cooperative society by-laws in simple words.

pacs.title: PACS services
pacs.intro: What your village Primary Agricultural Credit Society can do for members — membership, crop loans, deposits, inputs, procurement, storage and newer services.
pacs.askExample: What services does a PACS provide to its members?

financial_literacy.title: Money basics
financial_literacy.intro: Simple lessons on saving, interest, loans and EMI, choosing a lender, bank accounts, insurance, budgeting for a farm household, and avoiding fraud — with real examples.
financial_literacy.askExample: How do I compare two loan offers?

pmfby.title: PMFBY — crop insurance help
pmfby.intro: Common questions about Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana — eligibility, premium, enrolment, reporting crop loss, checking a claim, and the important dates.
pmfby.askExample: Am I eligible for PMFBY crop insurance?
